title: Too short
text: Too short. These aren’t long enough to reach between two cabinet handles. I have to use two interlocked together to get it to fit. So unless your cabinet handles are super close together, skip these.

product_metadata.title: Sliding Lock, U Shaped Baby Safety Child Cabinet Locks for Handles, Knobs, Doors (4 Pack, White)
features: A.Novel design: Mummed U shaped baby safety lock is suitable for D shaped handles and knobs.
B.High quality: we use the material of superior quality and it can bear 245 Newton. The edge is smooth.
C.Convenient: The sliding cabinet lock is reusable. It is completely easy to install.
D.Adjustable: The max length is 5.2 inches. Just place the lock on closed cabinet door’s knobs or handles and slide the bar until the lock is tight and cannot move any further
E. Package quantity: there are 4 packs White sliding cabinet locks in one set. If you have any question please feel free to contact us at support@mommedtech.
description: Are you still worried that your baby will be rummaging? Are you still worried about your pet cat stealing your food? The mummed’s sliding cabinet locks can eliminate these worries. Our products are made by high quality materials and through multiple testing. They can secure your cabinet doors with no tools, no drills, No magnets and no tapes. Our U shaped locks are very easy to put on or take off and leave no marks behind. The older children, parents and even grandparents can finish the installation in seconds. This design Works well with mushroom-shaped knobs and D-shaped handles. Thus, you can put them on the coffee table doors, media Consoles and closets in your living room, bathroom, bedroom and kitchen. Tips: keep away from the fire. Please stop using if any damage. This is not a toy. This product is suitable for D shaped handles and mushroom shaped knobs.
